name: Penta Infra GLN01 Geleen
notes: Official Penta Infra page identifies GLN01 as a carrier-neutral colocation data center on Chemelot Campus in Geleen, Limburg; capacity not disclosed on source page.

name: Systemec DC19 Venlo
notes: Baxtel Limburg market listing identifies Systemec DC19 Venlo as the largest Limburg data center with 1 MW; directory evidence only.

name: Cellnex Ittervoort edge datacenter
notes: Data Center Map lists Cellnex Ittervoort in Leudal, Limburg as a telecom/data tower with datacenter; capacity not stated.

name: Dustin DC Sittard / Unilogic Networks DC
notes: Data Center Map lists Dustin DC Sittard at Bergerweg 120, Sittard; described as a small Unilogic Networks data center.

name: NorthC Eindhoven 2
notes: Official NorthC facility page gives 4,000 m2 total surface area and 4.5 MW installed electrical capacity; construction press release said it was due operational in October 2023.

name: NorthC Eindhoven 1 High Tech Campus
notes: Official NorthC page lists the Eindhoven 1 data center at High Tech Campus with 2,500 m2 total surface area and 2.4 MW installed electrical capacity.

name: Colt Rotterdam Data Centre, Roosendaal
notes: Official Colt DCS page places its Rotterdam data centre in Roosendaal and states a potential maximum IT power of 15 MW and 11,400 m2 data hall space.

name: Eurofiber / Nedzone Netherlands South-West 2, Steenbergen
notes: Official Eurofiber page says the Nedzone data center is in Steenbergen, North Brabant, Tier 3 designed, with 3,300 m2 gross floor area and 2,200 m2 net data center space; MW not stated.

name: Previder PDC3/PDC4 Rijen
notes: Previder official page describes four Dutch data centers in Hengelo and Rijen with 13,600 m2 total floor area; Odin Group announcement confirms acquisition of Global-e Datacenter in Rijen, North Brabant.

name: Microsoft Middenmeer / Hollands Kroon datacenter campus
notes: Microsoft Local official page states Microsoft operates a datacenter in Middenmeer, municipality of Hollands Kroon, Noord-Holland; capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Project Nimble / AMS13-AMS14 expansion, Middenmeer
notes: Baxtel identifies a 50-hectare Middenmeer expansion site internally known as Project Nimble; DCD reported Hollands Kroon construction permission for AMS13/AMS14 in 2023 after prior permitting issues.

name: Google Middenmeer data center
notes: Official Google Data Centers page describes the Middenmeer data center north of Amsterdam and lists its 2020 opening milestone; capacity not disclosed.

name: Iron Mountain AMS-1 Amsterdam / Haarlem campus expansion
notes: Official Iron Mountain page says AMS-1 currently provides 13.1 MW, with a 10 MW expansion underway for expected completion in 2027 and another 20 MW expected; full build 43.1 MW.

name: NorthC Aalsmeer data center
notes: Official NorthC page locates the facility in Aalsmeer near Schiphol; DCD reported the facility had 14 MW IT capacity and a 4.5 MW expansion had broken ground.

name: Digital Realty Amsterdam data center portfolio
notes: Digital Realty official Amsterdam page lists 12 Amsterdam data centers and 79.8k m2 colocation space; W.Media reported opening of AMS11 added 27 MW and lifted Dutch capacity to 159 MW.

name: Equinix EN1 Enschede
notes: Official Equinix EN1 page gives address at Auke Vleerstraat 1, Enschede and 12,917 ft2 of space; MW not stated by official source.

name: Previder PDC1/PDC2 Hengelo
notes: Previder official page states its geographically separated data centers include Hengelo and are interconnected by fiber; Dutch Data Center Association participant page lists Previder PDC1 at Expolaan 50, Hengelo.

name: InterDC Enschede Haven
notes: Official InterDC page says it has four redundant Tier 3 data centers in Doetinchem, Enschede and Hengelo; Enschede presence confirmed but site-specific capacity not published on landing page.

name: InterDC Hengelo
notes: Official InterDC Hengelo page states the facility is ISO27001 and NEN7510 certified, designed to Tier 3 specifications, and can accommodate 70 racks / over 2,000 servers.

name: OCIX Sint Maarten / Open Caribbean Internet Exchange facility
notes: Inflect lists an OCIX datacenter at Falcon Drive / 3 Harbour View, Philipsburg with 1.0 MW and N+1 power; Internet Society and PeeringDB corroborate OCIX in Philipsburg at 3 Habour View, active IXP, but not the MW.

name: NorthC Nieuwegein - Utrecht
notes: Official NorthC page gives Nieuwegein-Utrecht general specifications: 8,000 m2 total surface area and 2.5 MW installed electrical capacity.

name: Eurofiber Utrecht 1, Groenekan
notes: Official Eurofiber page identifies Data Center Utrecht 1 at Koningin Wilhelminaweg 471, Groenekan; Eurofiber states it operates Tier 3 designed data centers in regions including Utrecht. Capacity not disclosed.

name: BT DC Nieuwegein
notes: Data Center Map lists BT DC Nieuwegein at Frieslandhaven 6; DCD reported BT expanded the Nieuwegein data center with a high-density server room increasing site capacity by 30 percent.

name: Cellnex Goes edge datacenter
notes: Official Cellnex edge datacentres page lists datacenter services in 24 Dutch telecom/data towers and features datacenter Goes with 550 m2 total surface area and 1050 kVA total capacity; Data Center Map corroborates Goes tower location.

name: Zeeland data center market - Goes facilities
notes: Baxtel reports Zeeland has three data centers operated by three providers, with Cellnex Goes the largest; Datacenters.com lists the Goes, Zeeland market with four data center records. Used as aggregate evidence beyond the named Cellnex site.

name: NorthC Rotterdam Zestienhoven
notes: Official NorthC page lists Rotterdam Zestienhoven with 10,800 m2 total surface area and 7.3 MW installed electrical capacity.

name: NorthC Rotterdam Waalhaven
notes: Official NorthC page lists Rotterdam Waalhaven near the Port of Rotterdam with 1,000 m2 total surface area and 500 kW installed electrical capacity.

name: NorthC Delft / TU Delft Campus
notes: Official NorthC page places the Delft data center on TU Delft campus with 5,000 m2 total surface area and 1.5 MW installed electrical capacity.

name: Smartdc Rotterdam
notes: Official Smartdc page says Smartdc Rotterdam is connected to the 23 kV network and built for Tier III requirements; DDA describes it as the largest and most unique data center in the Rotterdam region. Capacity not disclosed on official pages.

name: Eurofiber Data Center Rotterdam 1
notes: Official Eurofiber page identifies Data Center Rotterdam 1 as a Tier 3 designed data center operational since 2011; capacity not disclosed.
